_comment: T-5962 change-marker log for the fleet-usage period aggregates: anything that explains a trend break (a pricing or weights change, an optimization, a seat added or retired, a coverage change). Append only; scope is 'fleet' or a seat name; kind is one of pricing, optimization, seat, model, coverage, other. A change to the weights or price table in tools/fleet_usage_ledger.py needs a new 'pricing' marker carrying pricing_fingerprint() (test-pinned). Model and seat first-seen markers are derived from the aggregates on read and are not listed here.
